acceptedAnswer.text: The local luxury real estate market in Miami-Dade County significantly influences relisting strategies due to its dynamic nature, international buyer pool, and diverse property types. High-end condos in Brickell or South Beach, for example, require different marketing angles compared to expansive estates in Coral Gables or Pinecrest. Factors like seasonality, specific neighborhood demand, and the presence of new luxury developments can dictate pricing adjustments and marketing channels. Kelby Contreras leverages deep local market insights to craft relisting strategies specifically tailored to the nuances of Miami-Dade County's luxury segments.
